lines.text: Not a fresh catalyst: at 16:20 ET on September 30, 2026, NFT Ltd filed a private-placement agreement to sell 80,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.45 each for roughly $36 million, subject to closing conditions, and on October 5 the company said it knew of no undisclosed information or development accounting for the trading; the desk reads the contracted share count as a potential source of extreme dilution if the placement closes, with nothing in our sources establishing that closing occurred or when those shares become tradable. MI is up 11.4% since the previous checkpoint.

Not a fresh catalyst: the latest commercial news in our sources is the July 9, 2026 multi-country supply agreement with Fosun Diagnostics, followed by a July 16 shareholder update, while the September filings (an effective warrant-resale registration and ATM capacity) concern financing rather than business progress. The desk reads the Fosun agreement as a commercial-expansion story too old to account for today's session, with the September filings pointing to potential future share issuance from registered warrant shares and the ATM, and no evidence on whether the agreement has produced material revenue.

Fresh catalyst: an 8-K at 07:00 ET on October 5, 2026 disclosed a September 30, 2026 license agreement with Genentech covering certain GCase candidates, under which Genentech takes the lead on development, regulatory, manufacturing and commercialization while Alector keeps its Alector Brain Carrier platform and rights to its wholly owned pipeline, and the company said the deal extends its cash runway into 2029. The desk reads it as a company-specific validation and funding-runway event for a development-stage neurodegeneration company, with the upfront payment, milestones, royalties and total deal value not stated in our sources.
Not researched yet: there is no dossier on file for GSRF at this checkpoint.

The research could not tell: SEC filings were collected, including a Form 8-K at 12:07 ET on September 16, 2026 and the filing history dated October 1, 2026, but the excerpts do not describe the substance of the reported corporate events, and no company IR, newsroom or newswire coverage was collected, so an announcement published outside an SEC filing may not have been captured.

Not a fresh catalyst: at 13:20 ET on October 1, 2026, QTREX reported that a leading quantum-computing company independently tested its interconnect at 20 mK and measured more than 100 dB of channel isolation across the 4 to 8 GHz qubit band, described as 60 dB beyond the market leader, and said it was finalizing a binding definitive agreement with that unnamed company rather than having executed one. The desk reads the test as a measurable performance claim bearing on commercial validation of the platform, with the agreement unexecuted and its counterparty, terms, contract value and timing undisclosed.

Fresh catalyst: on September 1, 2026 the company announced that its IPO units would separate into Class A ordinary shares (JONE) and rights (JONER) with separate trading starting September 3, a trading-structure event for a newly public blank-check company rather than an operating or deal development. The desk reads the separation as creating a standalone common-share instrument that can change trading access and attention, with no business-combination target identified and coverage limited to SEC filings, so a driver outside them may not have been captured.
Not researched yet: there is no dossier on file for RAC at this checkpoint.

company.name: Alector, Inc.
company.business: Alector is a biotechnology company developing therapies intended to counteract neurodegeneration, including programs using its blood-brain barrier delivery platform.

why.headline: Alector disclosed a September 30, 2026 license agreement with Genentech covering certain GCase candidates. Genentech will lead development, regulatory, manufacturing and commercialization across indications, while Alector retains its Alector Brain Carrier platform and rights for its wholly owned pipeline. Alector said the partnership extends its cash runway into 2029. The agreement was publicly disclosed October 5.
